video_title: Could LeBron Play Tight End? Road Trippin’ DEBATES Zack Martin & Tyler Eifert

quotes.speaker: Tyler Eifert
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Eifert on the transition from basketball to football
quotes.excerpt: If you can't play basketball, you play football. That's the only thing I'm saying.
quotes.quote: We're just better athletes. So, if you can't play basketball, you play football. That's the only thing I'm saying. LeBron, he can jump and he can catch it, but if he was just going to block, he'd go, 'No!'

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Zack Martin's Pro Bowl selections
quotes.excerpt: Zack Martin has more Pro Bowls than Holden. Think about that.
quotes.quote: I grew up watching Zack. I've been a die-hard Cowboys fan. Did y'all notice about Zack? He has more Pro Bowls than Holden. Think about that.

quotes.speaker: Tyler Eifert
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Eifert on his recruitment to Michigan and Notre Dame
quotes.excerpt: I was all in on Michigan. I loved the helmets. I loved J. Long.
quotes.quote: I was recruited by a lot of the Midwest. I was all in on Michigan. I was obsessed with Michigan. I loved the helmets. I loved J. Long. J. Long was number one pick in the draft, left tackle. I was coming out, I was playing offensive tackle. I loved Michigan. I said if Michigan offers me, I'm going to Michigan. So I go up there and visit, they offer me, okay, yep. And then a month or two later, the head coach retires, right? Lloyd Carr, famous, you know, grandfather of the current quarterback in Notre Dame, C.J. Carr, right? So he retires, the guy from West Virginia, Rich Rodriguez, thank you, Rich Rodriguez came in. I went up there and visited. I didn't love what they had going on, right? They played the spread. I was like, I'm going to the NFL, I want to go to an NFL style offense. So my dad was like, you need to go to Notre Dame. You need to go visit Notre Dame, they're recruiting you. You know, I grew up Catholic, I grew up, you know, me too. I knew, I was the world's tallest altar boy. And I'm very proud of that. I love it.

quotes.speaker: Zack Martin
quotes.summary_phrase: Zack Martin on his transition to offensive line at Notre Dame
quotes.excerpt: They recruited me to play offensive line, right? What does that mean? Tackle, guard, whatever.
quotes.quote: They recruited me to play offensive line, right? What does that mean? Tackle, guard, whatever. I come in, I redshirt, I sit on the sidelines for a year, which is a new thing for me. But we got to go in the next year and I start playing offensive tackle and the rest is history. But Notre Dame, the tradition, all that, that's what, that's what drew me here.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on the physical toll of professional sports
quotes.excerpt: I lifted weights because I had to guard Shaq. And that workout for me, there's no weights you can lift for that.
quotes.quote: I think there's sections of it. Like if you were a guy that lifted weights every single day and that was your jam, that's going to be your jam for your life. I lifted weights because I had to guard Shaq. And that workout for me, there's no weights you can lift for that. There's no weights you can lift for that. He's lying. He was never known for guarding anybody.

quotes.speaker: Zack Martin
quotes.summary_phrase: Zack Martin on blocking Aaron Donald
quotes.excerpt: I had the opportunity, the privilege, if you would say, to block a guy named Aaron Donald.
quotes.quote: In my opinion here, so I got, I had the opportunity, the privilege, if you would say, to block a guy named Aaron Donald, right? So I don't know if you basketball guys know Aaron Donald, but in my opinion, right, everyone says Lawrence Taylor, all those, whoever you want to say, defensive player, Reggie White, whoever you want to say, Aaron Donald by far, in my opinion, my professional opinion, Richard, the greatest defensive player of all time.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on the financial independence of the Road Trippin' crew
quotes.excerpt: We don't share our money with anybody. And now no, that all the all these guys don't want to play us now.
quotes.quote: We're independent and we're making so much money and everybody's like, 'Oh, don't, what are you doing being independent?' And it's like, we don't share our money with anybody. And now no, that all the all these guys don't want to play us now. And I understand that with the way that, you know, the whole college football ranking is going and the the the college football ranking is backed by the SEC and ESPN and and all this stuff. There's an investment there. There's an investment there. There there ESPN has an investment in the SEC, so that's why like Alabama, two-loss team is ranked number five. And Notre Dame, a one-loss team is ranked 11. And that's also why Notre Dame is favored by seven against the number one team in the country. So make that make sense.
